title: Pipeline Evolution & Delivery Trade-offs
description: Tackle the trade-offs every production data pipeline accumulates as it grows: schema evolution under live consumers, streaming watermark choices, exactly-once semantics, idempotent backfills, and storage-format selection.
outcomes: You will reason about schema-registry compatibility under live consumers, choose streaming watermarks that bound state correctly, design producer-side exactly-once delivery, build idempotent partition-aware backfills, and select between columnar and row-oriented storage formats with clear trade-offs.
